# 知语乐 ZHIYULE

> ZHIYULE (知语乐) is a preschool Mandarin enrichment centre in Singapore for children aged 18 months to 6.5 years, run by Zhiyule Mandarin Space Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202647357C). Five progressive stages, PG to K2, build listening, speaking, reading and writing through music, stories, drama and multisensory play. The website is bilingual: English under /en/ and Simplified Chinese under /zh/.

Key facts:

- Ages: 18 months to 6.5 years, in five stages: PG (ZHIYULE Seeds), N1 (Sprouts), N2 (Stems), K1 (Leaves), K2 (Blooms).
- Lessons: PG 60 minutes; N1–K2 90 minutes. ZHIYULE is an enrichment centre, not a preschool or childcare centre.
- Address: 50A Jalan Jurong Kechil, #02-50A, JK Building, Singapore 598578 (Level 2), near Beauty World.
- Opening hours: Wednesday to Friday 09:00–18:30; Saturday and Sunday 08:30–18:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays. The centre is preparing to open; opening date and timetable are announced on the website and social media.
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone +65 8071 9508; email hello@zhiyule.com.sg.
- Fees, timetables and class sizes: not yet published; ask the centre.
- Trials: parents send an enquiry through the trial form or WhatsApp, and the centre confirms arrangements.

## Stage pages

- [PG · ZHIYULE Seeds](https://www.zhiyule.com.sg/en/programmes/pg/): a warm first connection with Mandarin
- [N1 · ZHIYULE Sprouts](https://www.zhiyule.com.sg/en/programmes/n1/): stories and words through movement
- [N2 · ZHIYULE Stems](https://www.zhiyule.com.sg/en/programmes/n2/): Chinese characters through touch
- [K1 · ZHIYULE Leaves](https://www.zhiyule.com.sg/en/programmes/k1/): create a story and find the words to share it
- [K2 · ZHIYULE Blooms](https://www.zhiyule.com.sg/en/programmes/k2/): bring stories to life and grow towards Primary 1
